title: Deduplicate preserving order
prompt: Implement `static List<string> Dedupe(IEnumerable<string> items)` — first occurrences only, **original order**, original casing kept. Null input returns an empty list.

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
var d = Solution.Dedupe(new[] {"a", "b", "a", "A", "b"});
Cj.Eq(string.Join(",", d), "a,b,A", "order and case kept");
tests.hint: "A" ≠ "a" — this is a set-membership filter, not case-insensitive dedup.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Trivial inputs must pass through intact.
